findingDetails.title: Templates README and worked examples still point at deleted checklist.md
findingDetails.evidence: README tree and key-files table still list addons/checklist.md.tmpl; examples still say See checklist.md; glob of templates/**/checklist.md* is empty.
findingDetails.recommendation: Remove checklist.md.tmpl from README and retarget example related-docs to the tasks.md verification section.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Glob templates for checklist.md* returned 0 files; README.md:105 and :141 still name the template.
findingDetails.claim: Template docs still instruct authors to use deleted checklist.md.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Docs are historical and operators only follow spec-kit-docs.json.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If README is generated from the manifest and the stale tree is already queued.

findingDetails.title: Packet verification checkboxes are unchecked while Status is Complete
findingDetails.evidence: extractMergedVerification spans protocol through summary and includes CHK-001..CHK-051 all open; evaluateChecklistCompletion returns INCOMPLETE; deriveStatus is in_progress.
findingDetails.recommendation: Check the merged verification items that this packet actually used, or stop extractMergedVerification at /ANCHOR:protocol so leftover template CHK rows do not veto Complete.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read tasks.md:109-196 and graph-metadata-parser.ts:1260-1315; summary end marker includes the CHK items.
findingDetails.claim: This packet would derive in_progress because merged verification CHK items are open.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: A sign-off end marker that excludes CHK items from the slice.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: deriveStatus is not run on this packet so the Complete table is operator-authored only.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If extractMergedVerification is changed to stop at /ANCHOR:protocol.

findingDetails.title: Plan still describes a pre-merge checklist fallback the live rule removed
findingDetails.evidence: Architecture still says merged tasks first, pre-merge checklist second; live _ac_traceability_file has no checklist.md fallback.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rewrite plan.md architecture to match the shipped tasks.md-only resolver.
findingDetails.claim: plan.md architecture still names the retired fallback.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: A second resolver that still prefers checklist.md.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: plan describes pre-change intent not post-ship state.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If plan.md is frozen as historical design and implementation-summary is the shipped contract.
